name: NuGet pack tooling
tagline: Discover, build, and pack selected Lyo.* packages with git change detection.
description: SDK-style `dotnet pack` for libraries under Lyo.Net. Packs only the projects you name or that changed. No ProjectReference walk. Pins Lyo package dependencies to last published versions. Fingerprints each project directory so unchanged packages are skipped. Refreshes tooling READMEs via tooling-docs before packing.

commands.blurb: Pack all Lyo.* packages as 1.0.0-preview (skips unchanged)
Pack all packages as a release version (no preview label)
Release-pack projects whose directory changed since the latest git tag (or HEAD~1)
Release-pack one package only (does not restamp Common)
Force rebuild of Encryption ignoring change detection
CI helper: same pack with SemVer / preview suffix handling
Build Encryption only; do not pack
Pack Encryption without compiling (needs a prior compile)
Push nupkgs one at a time; fail if all are duplicates or any push errors

notes: Local packs append the SemVer prerelease label preview (1.0.0-preview). Use --release when publishing a stable version so the version is used as-is

Selection is named patterns, --changed-since hits, or all packable Lyo.* projects. No upstream or downstream graph walk. Shared Directory.Build/Packages.props or Lyo.Net/assets/icon.{png,svg} changes select all packages
Nupkg Lyo ProjectReferences are pinned to last published (.build-state, nuget.org, GitHub Packages) unless that project is also in the pack set

GitHub Actions: Actions → CI - Pipeline. Branch model and feeds are in docs/ci.md. nuget.org Trusted Publishing setup is in docs/publishing.md (workflow publish-nuget.yml, Environment empty, secret NUGET_USER)
NUGET_OUTPUT_DIR defaults to ~/nuget-local; state file is $NUGET_OUTPUT_DIR/.build-state
build_nuget.py renders tooling READMEs once, then packs with SkipToolingDocsOnPack so each nupkg does not re-run tooling-docs
--compile-only and --pack-only are mutually exclusive. CI pack runs compile then pack --no-build on the same runner
ci_push.py skips a nupkg that already exists (409 Conflict) but fails the job if every package was a duplicate or any push hit a non-duplicate error
